text:
kyle_prod: Heads-up: we just shipped community-plugin-playground v0.2.0 to the org: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-plugin-playground/releases/tag/v0.2.0 :rocket:

andre_releases: Release published: community-plugin-playground v0.2.0 by @kyle_prod. Main changes: simplified starter templates, new sandbox orchestration example, and a demo deploy script.

mina_eng: nice! will the playground include the new safe-exec container for untrusted plugins?

kyle_prod: yes 1. The release adds a small sandbox wrapper (policy-limits.yaml example) and docs on running the safe-exec flow locally. Also added a quickstart that wires a plugin into the hosted api.

sophie_evangelism: planning a short livestream demo next Thursday 11am PT to show how to build a simple reranker plugin. want to feature a community maintainer example. anyone interested in presenting?

mina_eng: happy to demo the reranker example and talk infra choices.

andre_releases: tiny ops note: the release includes a new GitHub Actions workflow that auto-scores plugin PRs for compatibility. expect a 'compat-check' status on PRs.

community-bot: FYI: New repo badge added: "plays-nice" for sandboxed plugins. First-run will evaluate incoming PRs.

kyle_prod: can we draft a 2-3 line blurb for the community newsletter? keep it "how-to + link + RSVP". sophie, you taking newsletter copy?

sophie_evangelism: yep i'll draft and post in #community-announce for review. planning to include RSVP link for the demo and a short contribution call.

mina_eng: one ask: add a short section in the README about model-compatibility matrix. some community models need a small adapter to work with the orchestration example.

kyle_prod: good call, adding a compatibility section and an adapter snippet. PRs welcome.

andre_releases: tagging release artifacts now: cpps-v0.2.0.tar.gz (sha256: abc123...), demo-assets.zip. All signed.

sophie_evangelism: RSVP link posted: https://events.redwood.inference/community-playground-demo. please RT and share with community channels. :sparkles:

kyle_prod: thanks team. if maintainers want to be listed in the RELEASE_NOTES credit section, reply here with GitHub handle and short bio. we'll include folks in the showcase.

mina_eng: @mina_eng (ML infra engineer) - will add a 1-line bio in a PR.

andre_releases: archived release and pinned to community repos.

kyle_prod: closing thread 1 — open issues in the repo and tag 'playground' for follow-ups.
